source: Open-Meteo model-based QRN risk plus optional AEMET lightning observations
classification: Modelled thunderstorm/QRN risk, not direct lightning detection. Current conditions and six-hour forecast are reported separately.
limitations: AEMET observations cover only events returned by the API and the defined regional boxes.
Forecast CAPE never changes the current-risk classification.

aemet_lightning.interpretation: Mapa gráfico recibido; requiere georreferenciación para validar por región.
